note: External preseason comparators for the 2026 accuracy ledger. Captured 11 Sep 2026 from public git archives; every file was COMMITTED UPSTREAM BEFORE WEEK 1 KICKED OFF, and the upstream commit date is the timestamp. Names are verbatim from each source and are NOT joined to DELTA's universe here — join at grading time with the engine's own normaliser. See docs/ACCURACY-LEDGER.md section 8.

attribution.FantasyPros: Expert consensus rankings. https://www.fantasypros.com — redistributed openly by DynastyProcess.
attribution.KeepTradeCut: Community dynasty values. https://keeptradecut.com — values reproduced here with attribution for accuracy-ledger use.
attribution.StatHead: https://github.com/dachhack/stathead — the publisher's own projection model.

fantasypros_dynasty_ecr.publisher: FantasyPros, via the DynastyProcess data archive
fantasypros_dynasty_ecr.what_it_is: Expert consensus dynasty ranking. Lower ecr is better. best/worst are the extremes across the contributing experts.

dynastyprocess_values.what_it_is: Dynasty trade values derived from FantasyPros ECR. val_2qb is the superflex basis.
dynastyprocess_values.warning: NOT INDEPENDENT of fantasypros_dynasty_ecr. Measured on this exact file: Spearman between ecr_2qb and val_2qb is 0.997 (n=640). Treat the two together as ONE comparator, not two.

keeptradecut.publisher: KeepTradeCut, via the dachhack/stathead public archive
keeptradecut.what_it_is: Crowdsourced dynasty trade values from user head-to-head votes. val_sf is the superflex basis. Higher is better.
keeptradecut.note: Committed ten hours before the DELTA freeze and two days before kickoff. A genuinely different crowd from FantasyPros — this is the second opinion.

stathead_projections.publisher: StatHead (github.com/dachhack/stathead) — the publisher's own model, not an industry projection service
stathead_projections.what_it_is: Season stat-line projections for 448 skill players, WITH a projected games column. Built by the publisher from public inputs (prior-season stats, ADP, rosters, draft picks, betting lines) plus an anonymised consensus blend.
stathead_projections.scoring: ppg_half_tep was computed HERE by running each projected stat line through DELTA's own gamefp() at half PPR with TE premium (engine lines 143-148, read from the deployed file), then dividing by the source's projected games. The source's own pprPts is kept as src_pprPts for audit. Fumbles lost, two-point conversions and return touchdowns are absent from the source and are therefore scored as zero — a small net bias in the source's favour, since the omitted fumble penalty is larger than the omitted bonuses.
stathead_projections.graded_subset: Restrict the head-to-head to players this file projects for >= 10 games. Below that its per-game rate is conditional on appearing at all — Trey Lance is projected 1 game at a starter's rate, reading 18.8 ppg against DELTA's 1.6. That is two different questions, not a disagreement. The floor is fixed here, before grading: n=298 of the 376 frozen players.
stathead_projections.status: SECONDARY. See ledger section 8 — this cannot support a claim about industry accuracy.
